shortDescription: Demonstrates a double round-robin league season with travel distances and classic matches.
longDescription: Schedules 182 matches of a fourteen-team South American league onto 32 matchdays. Every pairing is played twice, once at either venue, and about 5% of them are classics, such as derbies. Once solved, no team plays twice on the same matchday or four matchdays in a row at home or away, no pairing is replayed the very next matchday, the classics land on a weekend, and the kilometres the teams travel between consecutive venues are as few as possible.
